note: Rejudged 2026-10-23 by an independent auditor (not the author) after 010e649057, which makes the final writer (session_ownership.go adjOutWrite.allow) send a synthesized withdrawal only to a destination holding an adj-out record for the route. RFC 4271 Section 3.1 allows a withdrawal only for "the IP prefix that expresses the destination for a previously advertised route". RFC 7311 Section 3.4.3: "Then, when R1 changes the next hop of a route from R2 to R1, the AIGP TLV value MUST be increased by a non-zero amount." The moved unit is TestRFC7311UnknownCostWithdrawsUntilMetricRecovers (both tags). Its initially-withheld subcases now first plant an earlier generation of the route at the destination (advertiseFirst) so the unknown/zero-cost withhold produces a legitimate withdrawal; the previously-advertised subcases are unchanged (announce 107, then lose the cost via readvertiseAIGP). Every subcase on the general and rs-cached rails still requires the last frame to be a pure withdrawal of 10.20.0.0/24 with no NLRI and no attributes, then recovery after metric 11 as exactly one announcement of the exact prefix carrying AIGP 111 (received 100 plus 11). Announcing next-hop-self without the increment, or adding the destination's cost, fails both polarities. The never-advertised subcase now emits nothing (RFC 4271 Section 3.1); that silence is not asserted by this carrier, but it cannot hide an unincremented announcement because the withhold decision precedes the writer's withdraw-or-silence choice and is exercised by every subcase. The absent-cost withdrawal remains Ze's safe refusal, not an RFC 7311 mandate. The helper aigpForwardToWire now primes adj-out through ownershipWriterForward when synthesized; its tagged callers TestRFC7311DirectLinkCostNeverWrapsOrDisappears and TestAIGPForwardedMetricsReachFinalWire are byte-identical and still assert configured-link sum 107 and a real withdrawal; TestRFC7311SourceLinkCostReachesRecipient (107/119, transparent 100) is unchanged. Ran: all four units PASS on 2026-10-23. FINDING (2026-10-23 audit probe): the re-fixture removed the only never-advertised recovery case. A scratch probe outside the tree (newAIGPReplayFixture, destination AIGPLinkMetric 43, unknown or zero cost, receive and forward with no advertiseFirst, then metric 11 and readvertiseAIGP) run through go test -overlay with the HEAD 010e649057 session_write.go and session_ownership.go gets 0 recovery UPDATEs where 1 carrying AIGP 111 is owed, for both unknown and zero cost: the withheld route is never sent to a destination it was never advertised to, because the AIGP recovery record (noteAIGPWrite) was taken only from the withdrawal that the final writer now drops. Before 010e649057 the initially-withheld subcases of TestRFC7311UnknownCostWithdrawsUntilMetricRecovers and the unprimed TestRFC7311ExtendedNextHopCostRecovery drove exactly this path; with advertiseFirst they cannot fail on it. An uncommitted session_write.go change by another session (aigpCostWithheld, noteAIGPWrite from the unfiltered withdrawal) makes the probe pass on the working tree; it is not committed and not judged here. Restoring the never-advertised subcases (no frame on withhold, then exactly one announcement with AIGP 111) is an RFC-tagged test change that needs owner approval, so it is reported, not made. For this row the verdict stays enforced: the non-zero increment is still proven on every announcement the carriers see (107, 111, 119), and no subcase can pass with an unincremented announcement; the lost recovery belongs to RFC7311-3.4.3-7.
